channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Greivis Vasquez | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Greivis Vasquez from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sean Marks on Greivis Vasquez
item.description:
Sean Marks:

“Greivis did everything we asked of him and more to try to get back on the court at full strength... The passion, grit and perseverance he has shown since he joined the team have been remarkable... We are thankful to Greivis for all of his efforts and wish him well in the future.”

Sean Marks on Greivis Vasquez, Nov 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @alexraskinNYC.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Greivis Vasquez
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Masai Ujiri :

“I want to thank Greivis... That's one of the toughest things I've ever done, is speak to Greivis after [we] made the trade.”

Masai Ujiri on Greivis Vasquez, Jun 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Greivis Vasquez
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Masai Ujiri on Greivis trade:

“We wanted to have some flexibility, open up a bit of space just to keep our options open as we go into free agency”

Masai Ujiri on Greivis Vasquez, Jun 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Greivis Vasquez
item.description:
Anthony Slater:KD on Greivis Vasquez' calling him Jesus of NBA:

“Greatest man to walk the Earth... I'll fail miserably if I try to stack up to that guy.”

Kevin Durant on Greivis Vasquez, Mar 24, 2014. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Pete D'Alessandro on Greivis Vasquez
item.description:
The Kings remain excited about what Vasquez adds and will do what they can to retain him.

“My feelings for Greivis haven't changed from the day we got him other than the fact that we had this deadline in front of us,”

Pete D'Alessandro on Greivis Vasquez, Nov 2, 2013. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Monty Williams on Greivis Vasquez
item.description:
Monty Williams:

“He busted his butt all year long. It's unfortunate that Paul had a great year also. The one thing we've talked to our guys about is when we lose something, to be gracious to the guy who won. I know Greivis is really respectful of Paul. It's unfortunate, but it's a sign we're headed in the right direction.”

Monty Williams on Greivis Vasquez, Apr 23, 2013. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Monty Williams on Greivis Vasquez
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Monty on Vasquez player of week award:

“It is (a nice honor) for the organization and Greivis. We’re proud of him. He’s worked his butt off”

Monty Williams on Greivis Vasquez, Jan 1, 2013. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.
